averaging_diagnostic.argmax_interpretation: Diagnostic only. Select the largest beta target patch at each valid query position. No nearest-neighbor retrieval or source residual. May duplicate patches and break spatial coherence; does not preserve soft-plan marginals or certify translation quality.
averaging_diagnostic.dominant_target_rule: One dog per query: highest original post-pruning image route, stable ID breaks ties. Same dog for native reference, target mean and patch argmax.
averaging_diagnostic.mask_rule: Original valid mask intersected with dominant-dog mass>mass_floor and dominant-dog conditional confidence>=original threshold. No fallback or confidence bypass.
averaging_diagnostic.variance_definition: Per-feature conditional squared Euclidean dispersion of target tokens. Within=sum_j pi_j Var_beta(y_j); between=Var_pi(E_beta[y_j]); total=within+between. Separate from within-image conditioning variance; fractions are not fractions of image blur.

partial.confidence_note: Raw retention differs from smoothed query confidence and thresholded mask coverage.

completed_pair_geometry.population: new successes in this attempt; excludes failures and previously registered pairs

data.resume_policy: Reuse registered successful pairs; restart unfinished/failed pairs from exact float64 feasible initialization.

data.interpretation: Training-source conditional routing before retained-edge renormalization; not partial OT rejection.

hypothesis: Diagnose averaging within a dog's transported patch map separately from averaging across dogs. Patch argmax is an experimental diagnostic, with no source residual or automatic quality acceptance.
interpretation: Compare the final three rows on the same mask. Full mixture vs dominant dog isolates dog averaging; dominant mean vs patch argmax replaces within-dog averaging with a hard readout. The original-mask mixture row isolates mask changes. Hard readout can break coherence or copy the reference; native controls and UMAP do not certify successful translation.

diagnostics.note: Feature diagnostics are not independent image-quality validation.

confidence_threshold_sweep.note: Counterfactual mask coverage only, from the same saved confidences; no fitting or image generation. Use held-out validation images to choose a threshold; confidence is not a semantic correctness probability.

summary.note: Descriptive feature diagnostics only; image means do not replace patch features for fitting or conditioning. Compare fixed generated images independently.
summary.partial_geometry_note: Fitted row statistics precede projection; source-neighborhood and projected-patch statistics include query smoothing. Dense pair metrics are weighted by routing and retained/support-valid mass. Projected-patch metrics average individual pair conditionals, not the final mixture across pairs. Image query neighborhoods precede the router; raw image weights precede selection/pair pruning. Their effective counts are descriptive, not additive or semantic correctness scores.
summary.patch_value_note: within_image_effective_patches/top1 describe the unchanged smoothed target conditional. conditional_displacement instead evaluates original plan-edge displacements and passes the query residual through; conditional_edge_mean uses the same plan edges without that residual. Source-neighborhood and norm diagnostics are separate; source_residual_norm measures the residual before retention/removal. Feature concentration and residual preservation do not certify dog realism or source correspondence.
summary.routing_note: Confidence/rejection are conditional on renormalized saved routes. Discarded routing mass is reported separately.

quality_review.rule: Inspect every column at native resolution. Accept only if clarity AND dog realism AND source pose/expression/color improve without greater reference copying or facial artifacts. A sharper cat-like image, or a retrieved dog, is not successful translation.

umap.feature_space: raw encoder patch tokens; valid-token means for image display only
umap.interpretation: No query or mapped points fit either reducer. Matched query records/masks across methods. Image means are display-only; transport uses unchanged patch tokens. UMAP is not a semantic score, and coordinates cannot be compared between rows or separately fitted runs.
